full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white mixed photographic portrait shows a stern middle-aged man in a dark suit standing before a field of repeated zigzag stripes. He faces the camera almost directly, occupying the center from the chest upward. His short wavy hair is combed back, and a white shirt and narrow dark tie make a bright vertical line beneath his face. A hard side light catches the forehead, one cheek, and the right side of his jacket, while the opposite half of his face and upper body becomes a broad near-black mass. His brows draw together above narrowed eyes; the straight mouth gives no hint of a smile. Behind him, thick white chevrons turn sharply across a black wall or graphic surface, their angular rhythm more forceful on the image right. On the left, smudged pale diagonal streaks interrupt the pattern and blend with the shadow over his shoulder. Rough scratches, scuffs, and uneven grain mark both the portrait and patterned ground, as though the image has been printed and distressed. The suit fabric is largely swallowed by darkness, yet thin highlights preserve the lapel and shoulder edges. The camera sits at approximately eye level, with a close crop that cuts the lower torso and leaves little open space. Light arrives from the upper image right, producing bright white zigzag segments and a stark divide across the face, while the left side stays dim. The overall composition is confrontational and uneasy, setting an immobile dark figure against aggressive repeating geometry in a worn monochrome surface.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白混合摄影肖像呈现一位神情严厉的中年男子，穿深色西装站在重复锯齿条纹前。他几乎正面面对相机，从胸部以上占据中央。短波浪发向后梳，白衬衫与窄深领带在脸下形成一条明亮竖线。硬侧光照亮额头、一侧面颊和画面右侧外套，另一半面孔与上身则成为大片近黑色。他皱起眉，眼睛微眯，笔直的嘴没有笑意。身后，厚白色折线在黑色墙面或图形底面上急转，画面右侧的棱角节奏更强。左侧，模糊的浅色斜笔痕打断纹样，并与肩上的阴影混合。粗刮痕、擦损和不均颗粒同时覆盖肖像与花纹底面，像经过印刷和磨旧。西装布料大多被黑暗吞没，但细亮部仍保留翻领和肩边。相机大约位于眼平，近裁切截去下半身，开放空间很少。光从画面右上方到来，使白色锯齿段明亮，并在脸上形成鲜明分界，左侧仍保持昏暗。整体构图带对抗性与不安感，把静止暗色人物置于强势重复几何纹与磨旧单色表面前。
style_prompt_en: The image has a distressed monochrome photo-graphic finish, where a stable central silhouette meets forceful angular repetition. Broad black masses and sharp off-white bands dominate, with only a narrow range of textured gray between them. Hard edges in the repeating geometry contrast with rubbed, scratched, and smoky passages that partially obscure it. A directional side light cuts across the focal volume, leaving one half defined and the other nearly absorbed by darkness. Fine print grain and streaks prevent the high-contrast design from feeling mechanically clean. Tight cropping and restless diagonal rhythm create pressure around the still center. The overall effect is severe, abrasive, and psychologically unsettled.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有磨损的单色摄影图形完成感，稳定的中央剪影遭遇强烈的棱角重复。宽大黑块与锐利灰白带占据主导，中间只有窄幅带肌理的灰阶。重复几何的硬边与擦磨、刮划、烟雾状色段形成对照，后者部分遮住纹样。定向侧光切过焦点体积，使一半清晰，另一半几乎被黑暗吸收。细印刷颗粒和条痕让高反差设计不显机械洁净。紧密裁切和躁动的斜向节奏向静止中心施压。整体效果严厉、粗砺，带心理上的不安。
theme_en: A severe monochrome portrait of a suited man before black-and-white zigzags
theme_zh: 黑白锯齿纹前一位西装男子的冷峻单色肖像
name: David Lynch
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
